# Parivar Restaurant

> Authentic Royal Nizami Indian & Mughlai Cuisine in Wiley Park, Sydney. 100% Halal Certified. Open late until 3:00 AM daily.

## Overview
Parivar Restaurant is a premier Indian restaurant situated in Wiley Park, South West Sydney (Canterbury-Bankstown region). Specializing in traditional royal Nizami and Hyderabadi recipes, Parivar delivers authentic slow-cooked dum biryani, clay-tandoor grilled meats, rich curries, freshly baked naan breads, meal combos, weekly tiffin service, and handcrafted desserts.

- **100% Halal Certified**: All meats and dishes strictly adhere to Australian Halal culinary standards.
- **Late-Night Dining**: Open every night until 3:00 AM (Mon–Sun).
- **Service Types**: Dine-in, Takeaway, Online Ordering, Daily Tiffin Service, and Event Catering.

## Menu & Signature Offerings
- **Hyderabadi Biryani & Mains**: Hyderabadi Chicken Dum Biryani, Hyderabadi Mutton Dum Biryani, Chicken 65 Biryani, Vegetarian Dum Biryani, Bagara Saffron Rice.
- **Tandoori & Entrées**: Tandoori Chicken (Half / Full), Chicken Tikka, Sheekh Kebab, Fish Fry (Basa), Chicken 65, Slow-Simmered Mutton Haleem.
- **Chicken Curries**: Butter Chicken, Achari Chicken, Chicken Khorma, Parivar Special Chicken Gravy, Chicken Vindaloo, Chicken Masala.
- **Mutton Curries**: Mutton Vindaloo, Mutton Khorma, Mutton Masala (Tender Australian Halal Goat).
- **Vegetarian Curries**: Daal Tadka, Mixed Veg Curry, Paneer Tikka Masala.
- **Desi Chinese**: Chicken Fry Noodles, Veg Fry Noodles, Chicken & Veg Manchurian, Wok Fried Rice.
- **Fresh Tandoori Breads**: Plain Naan, Garlic Naan, Butter Naan, Roti.
- **Savory Snacks**: Golden Samosas, Steamed Momos with Chili-Garlic Chutney, Vegetable Rolls.
- **Traditional Desserts**: Qubani Ka Meetha, Shahi Tukda, Gulab Jamun, Rasmalai, Zafrani Kheer, Khowa Puri.
- **Beverages**: Authentic Spiced Irani Chai, Sweet Mango Lassi, Assorted Chilled Beverages.

## Daily & Weekly Tiffin Service
- Homestyle 5-day and 7-day dinner subscriptions delivered warm across Sydney.
- Details: https://parivar.restaurant/tiffin

## Catering & Events
Parivar provides full-service Indian catering for Sydney weddings, corporate events, birthday parties, and religious celebrations. Packages feature live chaat stations, tandoori grills, royal biryani handis, and traditional dessert buffets.
Inquiries: https://parivar.restaurant/catering | Phone: +61 405 635 423
